verdict.rationale: Weave documents a programmatic evaluation framework: an Evaluation object with datasets and scorers, run as repeatable test cases to identify regressions. Its marketing says this catches regressions before they reach users, which implies pre-deployment use. Nothing in the evidence explicitly covers running evals in CI pipelines or gating deployments on results, such as threshold-based pass/fail exit codes or CI provider integrations. missing for 10: documented CI integration/recipes, deployment-gating mechanism (thresholds, pass/fail status), independent hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a developer, I can run evals in CI and gate deployments on their results

citations.quote: Weave provides powerful evaluation comparisons and visualizations to catch regressions before they reach users
measure your LLM application’s performance against repeatable test cases, compare changes over time, and identify regressions
the core of the workflow is the _`Evaluation` object_, which defines: A `Dataset` or list of dictionaries for test examples. One or more scoring functions.
a flexible evaluation framework to prevent regressions
